summary: v2 follow-up refactor retest. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from 48 → 59 tests, all 58 PASSED + 1 SKIPPED (test_patch_synced_forbidden intentionally). Covered NEW endpoints/features: (a) GET /api/admin/sync-preview shape {new_count, resync_count, users_with_gaps} — new_count reflects unsynced records, resync_count=0 without flag, gap detection returns {nama, entries:[{tanggal, gaps:[{from,to}]}]}. (b) GET /api/admin/sync-preview?include_resync=true returns resync_count for records synced <12h ago. (c) POST /api/admin/sync-records now returns {synced, resynced, failed} and accepts include_resync bool param. (d) SheetConfig accepts + returns master_lain_tab (default 'Aktivitas Lain'). (e) POST /api/records: type='lain_saja' is a SEPARATE lane — can be concurrent with type='utama'/'istirahat', but overlaps other lain_saja (400). (f) type='lain_saja' skips the aktivitas_lain inner-range enforcement (per spec). (g) type='lain_saja' with empty aktivitas_lain_list → 400. Frontend (390x844 mobile): ✅ 3-tier Beranda layout confirmed via bounding boxes — Row1: btn-input(y=570,w=175) + btn-input-lain(y=570,w=175) side-by-side; Row2: btn-istirahat(y=634,w=358) full-width; Row3: btn-inspect(y=698,w=358) full-width. ✅ /form-lain opens with Kode Produksi dropdown + Jenis Aktivitas dropdown containing 'Lainnya:' option at the bottom + Waktu Mulai/Selesai + Simpan button. ✅ Admin dashboard btn-sync opens Ringkasan Sync modal showing 'X entri baru akan disinkronkan pertama kali' + 'Y entri akan disinkronkan ulang' + 'Sertakan Re-Sync' toggle + 'Peringatan: Ada Time Gap' with per-user gap list + Batal/Sync Tetap buttons (label switches to 'Sync Tetap (N)' when gaps present, 'Sync Sekarang' otherwise). Toggle-resync switch re-fetches preview with include_resync=true. NOTE: Deprecated packages check — none of expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch present. Console warnings observed (non-blocking): 'Unexpected text node inside <View>' (carryover from iter2) + 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (from an RN Web dependency, not app code).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_check_overlap_with_existing correctly implements 2-lane overlap: q['type'] = 'lain_saja' if is_lain else {'$in':['utama','istirahat']} (line 432) — spec compliant.
server.py:_validate_record_times skips inner-range enforcement when type=='lain_saja' (line 415) — spec compliant.

server.py:_detect_user_gaps groups by (user_id, tanggal) and finds cur_start > prev_end gaps — correct. Note: only detects gaps INSIDE recorded windows; does not flag records outside regular shift bounds (that check is frontend-only in shift.ts, which matches spec 'INFO not fail').

server.py:sync-preview & sync-records both filter resync as synced_at>=cutoff (12h) using ISO-string comparison — works because ISO 8601 UTC strings are lexicographically ordered, but be cautious if timezone offsets are ever mixed. Currently only UTC 'Z-less' isoformat is stored so OK.

server.py:sync-master gracefully tolerates missing Aktivitas Lain tab (try/except → lain_rows=[]) — spec compliant. Also correctly skips wipe of master_data when lain_rows empty, preserving DEFAULT_LAIN seed.
form-lain.tsx (line 69) submits with type='lain_saja' — aligns with backend RecordCreate.Literal enum. Kode Produksi still required for context/audit.

dashboard.tsx: preview modal button label logic — should conditionally render 'Sync Tetap (N)' when hasGaps else 'Sync Sekarang (N)'. Confirmed via UI screenshot: label 'Sync Tetap (12)' shown when gaps present.
